name: Research Communication and Professional Ethics in Textile and Fibre Engineering (PhD)
description: The course covers the basic principles of communication skills to clearly articulate the understanding on a research topic to a broader range of audience. It includes the learning of the fundamental principles of writing the scientific matters by organizing the contexts and presenting the findings in a more quantitative manner with appropriate citations and referencing. The course covers the skill development tools on effective communication of scientific contents through oral and poster presentations. Moreover, the module covers learning on academic integrity and professional ethics. Designing the research approaches by considering the sustainable development goals to mitigate global climate change issues is also part of the course.
